title: On Hyperbolic Stochastic Galerkin Projections of Shallow Water Linearised Moment Equations
summary: In this work, we present an intrusive stochastic Galerkin formulation of the one-dimensional shallow water linearised moment equations expressed in conservative variables, using the pseudospectral product for generalised polynomial chaos expansions. The shallow water linearised moment equations constitute a hyperbolic system of partial differential equations with an arbitrary number of equations that enhance the accuracy of the standard shallow water equations.
